_about: Public-domain Charles M. Sheldon (1857-1946), Congregationalist pastor of Topeka, Kansas, for the Word Hoard: In His Steps: 'What Would Jesus Do?' in its first edition (Chicago: Advance, 1897), His Brother's Keeper (1896), For Christ and the Church (1899), In His Steps To-day (1921), The Mere Man and His Problems (1924) and his autobiography (1925), from Internet Archive scans. Most are 'sermon stories', religious novels read aloud to his congregation; each is flagged. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
